images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Cozy farming roguelite deckbuilder, hand-painted gouache storybook style, late autumn golden hour. Fixed three-quarter top-down camera (about 45 degrees) over a small farm: rolling ochre hills, orange and red maple trees, a red barn with white trim on the left, a stone well, a scarecrow, drifting falling leaves. Center: a 3x2 grid of tilled soil plots with wooden borders. Plot contents: ripe glossy red chili peppers being harvested right now — the chilies dissolve into golden sparkles and two chunky cream playing cards titled '불씨' with a painted chili illustration fly up out of the plot in an arc toward the right; a plot of round orange pumpkins; a plot of golden wheat with a small companion badge linking it to the pumpkin plot; a plot of leafy herbs; two locked plots drawn as faded dashed outlines with a padlock. Small cream wooden labels under plots: '우물 밭 120%', '문간 밭 100%', '그늘 밭 80%'. A small floating integer note above the chili plot: '+2장 · 나머지 40 누적'. Right side: a dark navy wooden 'winter deck' board titled '겨울 덱 10장' listing mini cards with counts (베기 ×4, 방벽 ×2, 불씨 ×2 glowing new, 정리 ×2, 수확 ×2 pending). Top: wooden season bar with spring, summer, autumn (highlighted, '가을 4/6턴'), winter night icon; water drops '물 7/10' and seed pouch '씨앗 4/6'. Small parchment preview at top right: '첫 겨울 밤 — 들쥐 떼 · 까마귀 떼 · 여우 · 굶주린 이리'. Warm amber light, paper grain.

images.screen: B · 겨울 밤 — 가을 도장 카드 셋을 한 바구니에 담아 칩 × 배수가 터진다. 남는 피해는 내년 씨앗이 된다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same painterly storybook farm on a deep winter night, same three-quarter camera: indigo sky, huge pale full moon, dark pine silhouettes, falling snow over a blue-white snowfield; the red barn on the left with snow on its roof and its door spilling warm lantern-orange light over the snow. Right: a lean starving wolf in dark navy fur with raised hackles and one glowing amber eye, frosty breath, a red health bar '굶주린 이리 51/51' and a speech-bubble intent '공격 15'. Center of the screen: a big Balatro-style scoring plaque made of carved wood and brass — a blue chip box showing '20' times a red multiplier box showing '450%', equals a huge glowing golden number '90' exploding with sparks, small bubbles listing '같은 밭 +50%p', '상강 +25%p', '이웃 호박 ×2'. Three cream cards lifted above the hand in a glowing basket row: '베기', '베기', '수확', each with a small ink stamp naming its field and season ('문간 밭 · 가을'). Below, a fanned hand with two more cards '불씨' and '방벽'. Bottom left: player panel '곳간 체력 41/55' with a farmer portrait; bottom right: four glowing paper lanterns as energy '0/4' and a wooden button '바구니 던지기'. Small floating text near the wolf: '초과 39 → 씨앗 +3'. Cold blue versus warm amber, cozy but tense, crisp readable UI.
